outcome: Neonatal outcomes (including respiratory distress syndrome, composite adverse neonatal outcome, intraventricular haemorrhage)
cohort: 813 mothers and 987 neonates delivered between 24+0 and 33+6 weeks gestation
finding: The aetiology of preterm birth is associated with neonatal outcome, independent of gestational age at birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the iatrogenic preterm birth group compared to spontaneous preterm labor and preterm prelabor rupture of membranes groups.
